oracle: cobc SORT/MERGE (libcob/fileio.c sort engine + work file)
doctrine: OBSERVED map of the SORT/MERGE surface (the last big surface gap, SORT/MERGE 145x). gnucobol-rs does NOT execute SORT -- it is a runtime sort engine over a work file (SD). This records the reordering byte-effect; it sorts nothing.

observations.name: USING / GIVING
observations.observed: USING reads the input file into the SD work file; GIVING writes the sorted SD records to the output file

observations.name: SD work file
observations.observed: SORT uses a sort-merge file description (SD) + a work file; it is a runtime sort, not an in-place reorder
